evals.prompt: Audit all blocks in the MIDES theme and tell me which ones have hardcoded texts or images that can't be edited from the WordPress admin.
evals.expected_output: A per-block report with texts/images classified as editable or hardcoded, followed by a summary table. Should correctly identify blocks with issues vs fully editable ones.

evals.prompt: Revisa el bloque contacto-info — ¿tiene textos hardcodeados que no se puedan cambiar desde el editor de WordPress?
evals.expected_output: A focused audit of only the contacto-info block, with clear classification of each text and image found in render.php.

evals.prompt: I just created a new block called hero-interior. Can you audit it and tell me if it follows the editability standard — all user-facing texts and images should be editable from Gutenberg?
evals.expected_output: Audit of hero-interior block only. Should read all three files and report findings clearly, including any missing editor controls for attributes that exist in block.json.
